entries.name: open-item-s1-protected-figures
entries.claim: A core-written figure leaves every generic create and update input.

kills.name: generic writes stay on drafts: core figures are nobody's input
kills.expected: a generic update wrote a draft fee note's balance

entries.name: open-item-s1-number-per-company
entries.claim: Issued numbers count per company and series.

kills.name: an issue numbers per company and series, freezes the figures, and a receipt applies
kills.expected: company B did not start its own series

entries.name: open-item-s1-line-set
entries.claim: An issue freezes exactly the line set the person confirmed.

kills.name: the line set is frozen: a changed line refuses the issue, a line write after issue refuses
kills.expected: an issue froze a line set other than the one confirmed

entries.name: open-item-s1-target-balance
entries.claim: No application takes a target below zero, even when two race.
entries.original:
if (amount > figure(target, row, binding.target.balanceFieldId))
          return refused('openItem.exceedsBalance');

kills.name: two receipts over-applying one fee note: exactly one succeeds
kills.expected: two receipts over-applied one fee note

kills.expected: a receipt settled a fee note in another currency

entries.claim: A grant is consumed only by the exact request it was attested for.
